name: Facethandle
description: Stand in the court stance with one rail forward and one back so both sides stay covered.

name: Granite Forearm
description: Jab the left short end at the opponent's guard hand while the right rail waits behind it.

name: Murk Gripbar
description: Cross the right rail over the left to turn a thrust toward the open side.

name: Decimating Forearmside
description: Rap twice from both sides with qi carried from the left rail into the right on the second hit.

name: Toxin Spinflip
description: Pivot on the lead foot and seize the opponent's wrist between the two rails with a charged squeeze.

name: Gustrap
description: Match the opponent's step in mirror and let a flick of qi carry you a pace beyond theirs.

name: Wrathful Knock
description: Close both rails across a trapped weapon arm and break it with qi where the rails meet.

name: Handledurance
description: Spin the rails in a lattice before the body and keep it woven with qi against a swarm of cuts.

name: Ferocious Shortshaft
description: Spin both rails in opposite turns around the opponent's guard and drive one decisive blow through the opening with full qi.

name: Granite Rearend
description: Crouch with the rails held like curled claws and the shoulders loose and ready to spring.

name: Rap Wrath
description: Peck the short end sharply into the same bruised spot on the ribs several times.

name: Chime Tonfashaft
description: Sweep the rail in a long blue-sky arc that clears incoming blows from the head to the hip.

name: Tonfaglimmer
description: Pace slowly around the opponent on light feet as a hawk circles above its prey.

name: Tapnerve
description: Close the rail and handle post on a limb like a talon and bind it with qi.

name: Rumble Tap
description: Drive two sharp qi-tipped pecks into a seam of the opponent's armor one after the other.

name: Chimebar
description: Slip the rail under a cut and lift it so qi turns the blade into the open sky.

name: Rumblebar
description: Fall from a short leap onto the opponent's guard and seize it down with the weight of both rails.

name: Rampaging Spinpeg
description: Swoop low across the field and sweep the rail through the knees of every foe within reach.

name: Merciless Iron Jolt
description: Dive from a leap with rail and handle post clamped on a limb like a talon and tear it away with full qi.

name: Thorn Elbowside
description: Hold both rails in a wide curve like a basin rim to catch whatever comes down.

name: Rumble Rearend
description: Jab from low where the guard is thin and let the stroke well up toward the chin.

name: Unconquered Sidehandle
description: Slice the rail across the line of a thrust like a current cutting into a bank.

name: Hogtying Tonfashaft
description: Press the rail into the opponent's guard a little more each moment until qi tips the balance.

name: Mightknock
description: Slide off to the side after a block as water runs off a basin when it spills.

name: Wrathful Jolt
description: Chain four fast raps along the forearm with qi surging between each like water over stones.

name: Toxin Knock
description: Spin both rails around a weapon in a whirlpool and draw it out of the opponent's hands.

name: Intenthandle
description: Burst forward with a wave of rapid strikes that floods every opening in the guard.

name: Eviscerating Roundend
description: Gather the opponent's force in the guard like water in a basin then let it overflow in a long barrage.

name: Aegis Gripbar
description: Hold one rail turning slowly forward and one turning slowly back before the chest.

name: Gust Sidehandle
description: Let the left wheel carry round and tap the knuckles of the sword hand.

name: Tapvalor
description: Catch a weapon's guard on the right wheel and hold it a heartbeat against the turn.

name: Gust Elbowside
description: Step on the toes through shallow ground while the wheels hold the line before you.

name: Tap Spine
description: Drag the rim of a wheel across the opponent's forearm to pull it from the guard line.

name: Tempered Roundend
description: Bring both wheels together on a wrist so the edges shear against it with a charge of qi.

name: Aegis Shortshaft
description: Spin the two wheels against one another so qi turns every blow into a glancing one.

name: Sanguine Spinflip
description: Drive the rail down a narrow channel of the guard with the rush of a mill race.

name: Rumble Spinpeg
description: Interlock the two wheels over a weapon and grind it against its owner's arm with qi.

name: Handlewrath
description: Chain a block and a strike on each wheel in turn so the rails never stop between blows.

name: Joltscourge
description: Break through a heavy blow with both wheels turning against it and return it in the same motion.

name: Tonfadurance
description: Hold the rails level with the eyes like a horizon and watch the whole body of the opponent.

name: Berserk Rap
description: Rap from high overhead with the long arm so the blow falls from the open sky.

name: Gust Handlepeg
description: See the cut begin from afar and turn it aside early with a light touch of the rail.

name: Silt Sidehandle
description: Back away three clean paces in a straight line so the opponent has no blind side to use.

name: Jolthavoc
description: Sweep the rail in a flat arc and push qi out along the line to land just beyond the wood.

name: Rapspine
description: Hook the far end of a weapon with a stretched rail and pull it away with a jerk of qi.

name: Thorn Tonfashaft
description: Turn the rails around the body to meet any blow and keep qi flowing evenly through the circle.

name: Berserk Forearmside
description: Raise both rails as one and bring them down in a single hammer that falls like a stooping bird.

name: Nova Handlepeg
description: Thrust the short end across an open gap and extend qi to the target a body's length beyond.

name: Facet Forearm
description: Gather all qi at the short end and loose it along one clear line to pierce a distant guard.

name: Inexorable Forearmside
description: Plant the stance low and wide with both rails across the body like the arms of a heavy gate.

name: Unsparing Spinpeg
description: Rap with both rails in measured time at the opponent's hip and collar.

name: Mayhem Spinflip
description: Hold a rail level at the opponent's chest and check the advance of the whole body.

name: Overpowering Knock
description: Cross the rails over a limb and bind it with the weight of the whole meridian network.

name: Gnashing Tap
description: Bring both rails down in a double blow weighted with qi from the dantian.

name: Chime Elbowside
description: Root the stance and receive a heavy swing on the rail so the force runs into the ground.

name: Raphavoc
description: Slam both rails onto a raised guard together so the whole network of qi lands at once.

name: Intent Rearend
description: Chain bind then break then slam with the two rails in a single flow of qi.

name: Gripbar Ruin
description: Bring both rails down from the full height of the stance with the entire meridian network behind the blow.

name: Aegis Handlepeg
description: Stand with the rails crossed over the heart as one stands to swear and hold the pose.

name: Sanguine Shortshaft
description: Speak the oath under the breath and jab the short end straight into the sternum.

name: Equipoise Tonfashaft
description: Hold the vow line with the rail and let nothing cross it as the blow slides off.

name: Blinding Rap
description: Advance a pace on the oath line without lifting the rails from their guard.

name: Grievous Forearm
description: Shove the rail into the chest with a pressed breath of qi that carries the whole body.

name: Ponderous Rap
description: Hook the long arm over the forearm and bind it fast with a qi that keeps the vow.

name: Tonfamettle
description: Block with the rail and let the wind of qi return the force of the blow along the wood.

name: Knockhavoc
description: Hammer the rail down on the line sworn at the start so the stroke lands exactly where promised.

name: Thornbar
description: Spin the rails in a wheel of gale qi that holds so long as the oath is kept.

name: Handlepeg Devastation
description: Hold the strike at the instant of commitment and release it with every held breath of qi in one blow.

name: Aegis Forearmside
description: Stand square to a chosen bearing and point the rail along it like a compass needle.

name: Gustknock
description: Poke straight into the face of the wind with the short end to slip under the guard.

name: Barmettle
description: Turn with the wind at the back and let the rail follow the blow past the shoulder.

name: Granite Sidehandle
description: Correct the bearing in mid swing and let qi steer the rail onto the true line.

name: Spinpeg Spine
description: Parry across the wind so the crosswind carries the blow off and brings the rail back.

name: Vanishing Rearend
description: Slip to the lee side of the opponent's weapon where the wind and the reach both fall short.

name: Piercing Tap
description: Thrust along a fixed bearing so the qi goes through the guard without bending off the line.

name: Might Jolt
description: Feel the wind shift in the opponent's blow and answer by turning the rail to meet its new angle.

name: Shattering Jolt
description: Take the true bearing and smash through along it with a gale of qi that bends nothing.

name: Obdurate Gripbar
description: Stand with the toes near the lip and hold both rails ready to receive a push.

name: Corroding Forearm
description: Poke the short end at the opponent's lead foot where it nears the rim.

name: Barnerve
description: Parry downward toward the drop so the blow falls away into the void beside you.

name: Lightning Knock
description: Slide the foot across loose ground without lifting it so the footing never shifts.

name: Rumble Shortshaft
description: Press the rail across the hip and walk the opponent along the line of the cliff.

name: Ironbar
description: Shove with qi behind the rail to move the opponent a full pace toward the rim.

name: Rumble Elbowside
description: Hook a wrist from the rimline side and draw it out into the open air.

name: Blazejolt
description: Rap with the wind behind the stroke so qi lands the blow with a sudden snap.

name: Unbowed Handlepeg
description: Roll the rail down the forearm to throw a cut aside and keep your own feet still.

name: Shadetap
description: Lever the rail beneath the opponent's weight and heave them past the rim with a surge of qi.

name: Gyverap
description: Wheel the rails around the opponent's arms and pin them against the body with steady qi.

name: Spinflip Reckoning
description: Drive the rail through the opponent's guard with full qi and carry the whole body onto the rim.

name: Aegis Roundend
description: Lean the body into the crosswind with the rails braced so the force passes around you.

name: Tempered Spinpeg
description: Rap the handle post out on a long reach and let the gust of the swing add its force.

name: Roundend Tenacity
description: Break the force of a rushing blow by catching it at an angle on the rail.

name: Silt Shortshaft
description: Drift to the side on a diagonal as though blown there and leave the blow behind.

name: Tonfaruin
description: Rake the rail across the target at an angle and let qi lengthen the sweep by a hand.

name: Rumble Knock
description: Hook the weapon arm and reel it in with a gust of qi that pulls the stance forward.

name: Charter Sidehandle
description: Spin the rails flat and wide like a sail and use qi to hold it taut against blows.

name: Hellish Rearend
description: Thrust the short end into the crosswind and let qi carry the point far past the wood.

name: Tonfawrath
description: Chain wheeling strikes across the body in turn so each rides the wind of the last.

name: Booming Hour Spinflip
description: Keep both rails flying in a long storm of qi-backed blows that never gives the opponent time to counter.

name: Granite Gripbar
description: Stand on open ground with the rails held out wide and rely on movement rather than cover.

name: Iron Forearmside
description: Jab from the open stance straight at the face without any shelter on either side.

name: Torrent Roundend
description: Parry with a small outward turn of the rail so the blow spends itself on empty air.

name: Impervious Tonfashaft
description: Spin the rails in the open and let qi close the circle from every side at once.

name: Mighthandle
description: Rap the unguarded flank of an opponent who has turned to face another fight.

name: Silt Tap
description: Cross open ground in a zigzag pace so that no single line of attack follows you.

name: Hoarfrost Elbowside
description: Hold a ring of turning rail around the body with qi so the guard covers every direction at once.

name: Tempered Jolt
description: Open the guard as bait then spin back through the attacker's arm with a blow of charged qi.

name: Vengeful Roundend Havoc
description: Throw the rails wide beneath the open sky and bring them in as one stroke of full qi.

name: Hoarfrost Handlepeg
description: Open the reading with the rails held loose and let the first breath of wind test the guard.

name: Sanguine Forearm
description: Jab with the full weight of a heavy stance behind the short end.

name: Handlemettle
description: Cross the rails on the chosen bearing so the blow is parried along the line you hold.

name: Torrent Rearend
description: Take one long step on the draft of the opponent's own swing and arrive inside it.

name: Chime Forearmside
description: Check the opponent's rising arm with the rail laid across it and the wind at your back.

name: Blistering Jolt
description: Shove with the rail while the open gale of qi leans the whole body behind the push.

name: Ponderous Tonfashaft
description: Lock the opponent's arm between both rails and hold it with a steady gale of qi.

name: Torrent Shortshaft
description: Draft the rail along the opponent's blow and turn it back on its own line with qi.

name: Lacerating Sidehandle
description: Slam the rails down together with the full weight of the stance and a gale of qi behind them.

name: Unbudging Gripbar
description: Spin heavy rails in a covering flurry that the open gale keeps turning against blows.

name: Blaze Knock
description: Sweep both rails through the whole width of the guard with the open gale in every fiber of the meridian network.
